summary: Criminal complaint vs civil contempt; same factual matrix abuse of process; sanction under s.197 CrPC required as acts performed in official capacity; cognizance without sanction improper; High Court failed to consider dismissal of prior contempt petition; witness testimony lacks specific dates and details; criminal proceedings barred by abuse of process and official immunity.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.107, s.141, s.197, s.200, s.202, s.203, s.482
Indian Penal Code s.294, s.323, s.427, s.447, s.506B, s.34, s.341
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; cognizance set aside; criminal proceedings quashed; High Court's order allowing cognizance reversed.
